summary: The filing is an SEC Form 6-K by Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV reporting the results of its 29 April 2026 Annual General Meeting. The meeting approved the 2025 annual accounts, a gross total dividend of EUR 1.15 per share (with remaining EUR 1.00 payable), and routine resolutions including director appointments/reappointments, discharge of directors and auditor, remuneration policy, and share buyback authority. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or activist campaign is disclosed. This is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer.
